common_comparison_controls.note: Signal/exit logic follows each public style reconstruction; position-risk budget is normalized so results compare style edge rather than wealth/leverage.

data: Binance official USD-M aggTrades, aggregated to 5-second bars; 5m derived; taker direction from buyer-maker flag. No historical full L2 order book claimed.

fidelity.Paul Rotter: LOW: historical L2/order book unavailable; 5-second aggressor-flow failed-break proxy only
fidelity.Testa: MEDIUM-LOW: public supply/demand+tape philosophy mapped to 5-second Binance aggressor flow; no historical order book
fidelity.BNF: MEDIUM: classic public 25-day MA-deviation reversal rule used literally; single-asset BTC cannot reproduce stock-selection breadth
fidelity.cis: MEDIUM: public momentum/trend-follow + quick-loss/let-winner-run philosophy mapped to 5m BTC
fidelity.Tom Hougaard: MEDIUM-HIGH: public 5m price-action/engulfing entry, structural stop, add-to-winner and trailing logic reconstructed from his own material
fidelity.Jun FX: MEDIUM: public high/low, breakout/failed-break and market-psychology seconds-scalp logic mapped to 5-second BTC
fidelity.Hansan: MEDIUM: public trend-follow breakout and immediate-invalidation seconds-scalp logic mapped to 5-second BTC

style_basis.Paul Rotter: order-book scalper; 3-5 ticks; close quickly when trade goes against
style_basis.Testa: short-horizon scalping; board/tape supply-demand; cut when thesis fails
style_basis.BNF: classic negative deviation from 25-day MA and rebound
style_basis.cis: buy strength / sell weakness; fast loss cutting; focus on total P&L
style_basis.Tom Hougaard: price action/mechanical entries; chart/ATR stops; add to winners; no fixed target
style_basis.Jun FX: seconds scalping near significant highs/lows; breakout or failed-break depending on market psychology
style_basis.Hansan: trend-follow breakout; enter before/at/just after line; very fast invalidation, avg FX stop about 1 pip
